basics.name: Mayank Singh Rathore
basics.headline: Lead DevOps Engineer | AI Enthusiast
basics.summary: Seasoned DevOps Engineer with 8+ years of expertise in architecting and implementing cloud-native solutions across AWS and Azure. Specialized in Infrastructure as Code (IaC), container orchestration with Kubernetes/OpenShift, and CI/CD pipeline automation, delivering 99.9% uptime SLAs for enterprise-grade systems. Proven track record in cloud migration strategies, reducing infrastructure costs by 40% through optimization and automation while improving deployment frequency by 10x. Skilled in designing fault-tolerant, auto-scaling architectures, leveraging microservices patterns, service mesh implementations, and GitOps methodologies. Adept at leading cross-functional DevSecOps initiatives, implementing observability frameworks with Prometheus/Grafana/ELK stacks, and driving infrastructure modernization programs that accelerate time-to-market by 60%. Currently expanding expertise in MLOps, LLMOps, and AIOps to bridge traditional DevOps practices with emerging AI/ML workloads.
